about_the_game:
Adventure Story

You are a sword cultivator with a mysterious past, fleeing from a village catastrophe, and embarking on an unknown world shrouded in black mist with your childhood companions. Rescue corrupted beings, meet enigmatic martial artists and ancient descendants, and uncover ancient secrets. In turn-based combat, teamwork and skill coordination become the key to defeating powerful enemies.

Turn-Based Tactical Combat

Recruit partners with unique skills to form a team that spans the vast world. In turn-based battles, use clever skill and equipment combinations to overcome formidable foes, and explore this vast wilderness together.

Pre-Battle Preparation

Before every battle, you can arrange your troops and switch characters' equipment and combat skills during the preparation phase. You can also reassign innate attributes to adapt to special combat scenarios.

Battle Rewind

During battles, you can rewind every move at any time, eliminating the risk of mistakes. This also allows you to quickly test different skill casting sequences and attack combinations.

Unique skill design

Each character has skills tailored to their persona, while every boss has unique skills and combat mechanics. You need to reasonably combine characters' skills, understand enemies' mechanics, and achieve victory through mutual understanding.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300
  • Memory: 4G GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support

short_description: "The Great Wastes" is a pixelated fantasy RPG. Players take on the role of a mysterious young man living in an isolated village. One day, the village is suddenly attacked by a group of unidentified black-clad individuals, forcing the young man to flee with his childhood sweetheart and companions.
